title: Presidential Office Building, Taipei
axis: +X north-northeast along front facade, +Z east-southeast toward Ketagalan Boulevard, +Y up.
source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap original main polygon with two courtyard holes and native building parts, checked against local aerial/original exterior photographs and official double-courtyard description.
identityStatus: Native building identity matches Presidential Office POI; courtyard holes and four corner towers correspond to the inspected local aerial. Main tower60m native metadata corroborates official source.
geometryLabel: Native main ring and two retained courtyard holes; separate original parts retained for signed geographic controls. Security/service annexes excluded.

terrainContact.basis: Dry front forecourt on entrance axis beyond native porch outline, chosen before independent source field and geometry. Not courtyard or roof.

scope: Main surviving red-brick presidential office quadrangle with central60m tower, four corner towers, two flat guard towers, paired open courts, central hall and current entrance porches. Detached service/security buildings and precinct landscaping excluded.
limitations: Native vector is quantized and simplified; metre-scale wall/bay/roof details interpreted from photographs, not a site survey.
North facade intentionally has no external portico; hidden north/west details and octagonal chamber interiors generalized.
Urban composite ground may differ from actual paved grade and other hosts. No flattening or fitting is allowed.
